content: On reception of the UDS Service WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E), if all signals ( DcmDspDidSignal ) of the DID have fixed length ( DcmDspDataType is different than UINT8_DYN), the Dcm module shall check if the received data length corresponds to the DID data length (addition of all DcmDspDataByteSize ).
